Name: Salty's Wizard Portrait for RRRR
Author: saltybleu
Description:
[b][size=3]!! Now works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard[/url]﻿ !![/size][/b]
I checked the perms and I think this is okay, but I can take it down if it's not! (˃̣̣̥ᯅ˂̣̣̥)


This portrait is drawn to match RRRR's wizard. I wanted to draw a version for myself that's shoujo manga-esque (and less pink). Keyword: -esque. I was largely inspired by works like Yubisaki to Renren and Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki, but I make no promises that it looks like that!


[size=3][b][color=#00ff00](Main Version)[/color] Installation Guide:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download the most updated version of the required dependencies: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3130]Scale Up 2[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284/]Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR (and all its own dependencies)[/url]﻿﻿
[*]When downloading [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard[/url]﻿﻿, choose only [b]ONE[/b] version. Either Event or Config, but NOT both. My mod should automatically work for whichever version you choose.
[*]Unzip the main file and place the folder "[CP] Salty's Wizard for RRRR" into your Mods folder along with all the dependencies.
[*]That's it!
[/list]*note: Remember to download all of RRRR's dependencies!
**note: Portraiture is [b]NOT[/b] required for this version

Theoretically, it should work just fine, but as I am only one person, there might be some parts I overlooked. If there are any problems with the mod, post a comment and I'll try my best to resolve the issue.


[b][size=3](Portraiture) Installation Guide:[/size][/b]
Only if you want to use the portraiture version! This version is [i]not compatible[/i] with Jello's Vanilla-ish portraits. It is only the base portrait![list=1]
[*]Unzip the main file and rename the image file to Wizard.png
[*]Go to your mods folder or wherever you put the Portraiture folder.
[*]Move the Wizard.png to your Portraiture folder. The file path should look something like this: "Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/<whatever your folder is called>"
[/list]*note: Wizard.png should be the correct name for RRRR, but you might need to rename it to Magnus.png if it doesn't show up

If you like this style, please consider using my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33712]Camilla portrait[/url]!! It's the only other one so far :D


[b][size=3]Credits:[/size][/b][list]
[*]Chaekal and Rizum, Gigi, atelier99 and Jellonip for the Wizard design
[*]Art drawn by me (saltybleu)
[*]Referenced Jello's code in order to make this mod compatible with the seasonal wizard!
[/list]

[b]Extra Details and Rambling:[/b]
This mod also includes a portrait for the SVE Mermaid that you can toggle on and off in the config! The Wizard portrait is also an on and off toggle, though I'm not entirely sure why you'd download this mod if you weren't planning on using my painstakingly drawn Wizard portraits LOL Nevertheless, the option is there.

Mermaid: [spoiler]I drew her because I'm low-key obsessed with the ocean and she only has 4 expressions! I didn't feel the need to post her portrait as a separate mod, but idk
